rules.when: No changed path or migration material triggers any control in lf_ci_control_impact_registry_v2 and no lane-required control can be established from durable evidence.

The commit/PR changed PASE-controlled material and has independently verifiable current evidence equivalent to the skipped controls, bound to exact source/head. For migration changes, Train execution plus exact apply/readback/parity or equivalent durable ledger/source evidence is required. Workflow logs alone are insufficient.
Any PASE-controlled material lacks exact durable equivalent evidence, has ambiguous original head, or depends only on skipped workflow/log evidence.
